projects.name: [Core] Integrated dashboard for drone-based sheep detection
projects.description: An early-stage direction to bring drone-based sheep detections into an integrated dashboard. The scope and presentation of the system are still being explored.

projects.name: [Internship] Sheep prediction and drone following
projects.description: Improve sheep detection through better drone positioning, with the aim of enabling the drone to follow sheep more closely.

projects.name: [Core] Small-sheep detection with high-altitude drones and LoRA-supported data synthesis
projects.description: Combining high-altitude drone imagery with synthetic-data generation to improve detection of small sheep. Next steps include establishing the LoRA pipeline, data extraction and model training.

projects.name: [Core] Robot-assisted RF surveying and control for agricultural deployments
projects.description: The planned work combines radio-frequency surveying, connectivity assessment across farm obstacles, robot control and link drop-off estimation. It brings together earlier directions on long-range LoRa evaluation, reliable field control and site-wide connectivity surveys.

projects.name: [Core] Retinex for improving sheep detection
projects.description: The Retinex-based sheep-detection work is complete, but its findings have not yet been published. A write-up or preprint is in progress.

projects.name: [Core] Gaps in robot-animal interaction: policy submission
projects.description: Proposed DEFRA policy submission identifying gaps in current understanding and guidance for interactions between robots and animals.

projects.name: [Internship] Quantitative sheep behaviour dashboard
projects.description: A follow-on to Sheep Radar focused on improving the detection and behaviour-modelling pipeline with additional data and refined or new models. The work could build towards more reliable estimates of flock behaviour, including separation, alignment and cohesion, and a dashboard to explore these measures.

projects.name: [BSc Project] Improved sheep behaviour modelling with a citizen-science game
projects.description: Planned BSc project exploring whether a citizen-research game can gather useful observations to improve sheep behaviour models. This develops the earlier ShepherdingSim game proposal; the project scope is to be agreed with participants.

projects.name: [Core] GPS-encoded labelled dataset for benchmarking sheep tracking
projects.description: Proposed dataset combining sheep-tracking labels with GPS information to support benchmarking and comparison of tracking approaches.

projects.name: [BSc Project] Multi-bounding boxes for occlusion-aware sheep tracking
projects.description: Proposed study of multi-bounding-box methods to better represent partially occluded sheep and improve flock tracking.

projects.name: [MSc Project] Robotic sheep herding with closed-loop behaviour modelling
projects.description: Proposed research combining sheep detection and simulation to investigate how animal behaviour models can inform a robot's herding decisions and their feedback into the system.

projects.name: [MSc Project] Sheep responses to prolonged robot-dog exposure
projects.description: Investigate how sheep respond to longer exposure to a robot dog, including the effects of verbal cues, visual analogues and the robot's colour.

projects.name: [MSc Project] Multi-robot flock management for slower robot dogs
projects.description: Investigate whether using two or more slower robot dogs can compensate for their lower individual speed compared with a real sheepdog, with simulation focused on driving and coordinating at least two robots around a flock.

projects.name: [BSc Project] Intuitive farm control for a robot dog
projects.description: Develop farm-friendly control for the robot dog using intuitive commands and traditional whistle-based cues familiar to shepherds.

projects.name: [Core] Economics and ethics of robot shepherding
projects.description: Proposed journal article reflecting on market, economic and ethical questions raised by robotic shepherding.

projects.name: [Core] Guidance for ethical robotics around animals
projects.description: Develop a practical whitepaper outlining considerations for the design, evaluation and responsible use of robots around animals. Bring together evidence and perspectives on animal welfare, human oversight, regulation and stakeholder responsibilities.

projects.name: [Core] Live sheep clustering and map visualisation
projects.description: Add real-time sheep clusters, trail history and interactive map overlays to make flock observations easier to interpret.

projects.name: [Workshop] AgriFoRwArdS 5th Annual Summer School: Going to the Dogs
projects.description: Explored the viability of each Auto Shepherd subsystem and carried out preliminary work across the system during the fifth annual AgriFoRwArdS Summer School.

projects.name: [Blog] AgriFoRwArdS Summer School 2025: Robotic Shepherding
projects.description: Blog post reflecting on the CDT Summer School 2025 robotic shepherding work and the ideas developed during the week.

projects.name: [Blog] Working with the Unitree GO2 Edu
projects.description: Proposed practical blog post sharing experience and lessons from working with the Unitree GO2 Edu robot.

projects.name: [Presentation] From Bark to Byte: Auto-Shepherd infrastructure for precision herding
projects.description: Completed outline for a planned ROSCON UK 2027 contribution, describing the interconnected infrastructure being developed for precision herding.
